CREATE OPERATOR === (
        PROCEDURE = int8eq,
        LEFTARG = bigint,
        RIGHTARG = bigint,
        COMMUTATOR = ===
)

CREATE OPERATOR !== (
        PROCEDURE = int8ne,
        LEFTARG = bigint,
        RIGHTARG = bigint,
        NEGATOR = ===,
        COMMUTATOR = !==
)

SELECT  ctid, oprcom
FROM    pg_catalog.pg_operator fk
WHERE   oprcom != 0 AND
        NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator pk WHERE pk.oid = fk.oprcom)
shape: SELECT ctid, oprcom FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator AS fk WHERE (oprcom != 0) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator AS pk WHERE pk.oid = fk.oprcom));
